positions.as_written: Use the epicondylar axis as the working approximation in surgery and keep its approximate status in mind.
Expect a single axis brace or external fixator spanning the knee to fit the limb imperfectly through range.
Treat the centrode as the design variable that single radius and multi radius implants disagree about.
Expect deep flexion behaviour to differ between single and multi radius designs on kinematic grounds.
Consider component position before design when a replaced knee's motion is wrong.
Keep intraoperative axis measurement distinct from the functioning knee's behaviour.
